column2: ESTABLISHMENT  OF  THE  NATIONAL  AUTHORITY  FOR  THE
IMPLEMENTATION  OF  THE  CHEMICAL  WEAPON’S  CONVENTION
(1)  For  the  purposes  of  this  Act,  the  Minister  shall

column1: establish an Authority to be known as the National Authority
for  Implementation  of  the  Chemical  Weapons  Convention
(hereinafter referred to as “the Authority”).

column2: (2)  The  Authority  shall  by  the  name  assigned  to  it  by

column1: subsection (1) be a body corporate and shall have perptual
succession and a common seal and may sue and be sued in
such name.

column2: (1) The Secretary to the Ministry of the Minister in

column1: charge of the subject of Industries shall be the Chairman of
the Authority and shall be charged with the implementation
of the Act.

column2: (2)  There  shall  be  a  Secretariat  to  assist  the  Authority

column1: headed  by  the  Director  appointed  under  section  8.  The
Secretary shall appoint to such Secretariat such number of
officers  of  the  Ministry  as  may  be  necessary  to  assist  the
Director of the  Authority in the exercise, performance and
discharge of the  powers, duties and functions assigned to or
conferred on the Director under the Act.

column2: (1) The Seal of the Authority shall be in the custody

column1: of the Chairman of the Authority and may be altered in such
manner  as may be determined by the Authority.

column2: (2) The application of the Seal of the Authority shall be

column1: authenticated  by  the  signature  of  the  Chairman  of  the
Authority, and any other officer of the Authority authorized
to  authenticate    the  application  of  the  Seal.
